description: Runs log lines through a real wazuh-manager 4.14.9 (fresh logtest session) with your custom rules and decoders: which decoder and rule matched, whether YOUR rule fired, and load warnings such as 7617/7619. Logtest engine: frequency/timeframe rules and some live-only behaviour are out of scope. Free: 1 log line with your files (3 with the stock ruleset only), summary. 10 lines with decoded fields and full alerts: POST https://atkvn.com/agent/v1/wazuh-testfire (x402, USD 0.10).
